package sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.web;

import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.service.ClaimQueryService;
import sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.web.dto.ClaimView;

@WebMvcTest(ClaimController.class)
class ClaimControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockBean
    private ClaimQueryService claimQueryService;

    @Test
    void byId_found() throws Exception {
        when(claimQueryService.find("CLM-0001")).thenReturn(Optional.of(new ClaimView("CLM-0001", "SUBMITTED")));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/claims/CLM-0001"))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.status").value("SUBMITTED"));
    }

    @Test
    void byId_unknown_is404() throws Exception {
        when(claimQueryService.find("CLM-9999")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/claims/CLM-9999"))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
    }

    @Test
    void byMember_returnsList() throws Exception {
        when(claimQueryService.findByMember("S****567A")).thenReturn(List.of(new ClaimView("CLM-0001", "PAID")));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/claims/member/{nric}", "S****567A"))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].claimId").value("CLM-0001"));
    }
}
